analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($0.21) vs SMA5/20/50($0.22/$0.21/$0.20): Short-to-mid term trend consolidating around the middle band.
· Position vs SMA100/200($0.18/$0.22): Mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week position (8.5%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.8→51.1) + Trading in neutral territory + Weakening momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0001→-0.0007) + Slight improvement + Weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $0.21) + Bandwidth at 19.12%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.19) + Basis (Bollinger lower band, Pivot S1).
· Swing resistance ($0.21) + Breakout expected to confirm SMA20.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Consolidation) + Lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x) + Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Consider entry after further directional confirmation.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 $0.21은 SMA20 및 볼린저밴드 중단과 일치하며, 5일 저가 $0.21, 20일 저가 $0.19로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성. 그러나 5일 고가 $0.23, 20일 고가 $0.26으로 Lower High 패턴도 동시에 관찰되어 횡보 구간 지속 진단.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price of $0.21 aligns with the SMA20 and Bollinger Band middle line. While the 5-day low of $0.21 and 20-day low of $0.19 suggest potential for a Higher Low pattern, the 5-day high of $0.23 and 20-day high of $0.26 also indicate a Lower High pattern, confirming a consolidation phase.
